title: Computational analysis identifies pathogenic nsSNPs in ATG10, an E2-like ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme of the autophagy pathway.
authors: Arpna; Gharib, Ali Gharib; Sharma, Arti; Parkash, Jyoti; Changotra, Harish
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算工具和MD模拟分析自噬相关蛋白Atg10的致病性nsSNPs及其结构影响，虽涉及蛋白稳定性与互作，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅预测转录因子结合位点，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Autophagy related gene 10 (Atg10), an E2-like enzyme, is essential for two ubiquitin-like modifications in autophagosome formation: Atg12-Atg5 conjugation and MAP-LC3 lipidation. It is involved in various types of cancers, neurodegenerative disorders, autophagy-related disorders, and treatment responses to cancer. Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in ATG10 are associated with several diseases contributing to genetic predisposition in patients. In this study, we employed various in silico tools to examine Atg10 to identify molecular signatures that could act as molecular markers. We analysed deleterious non-synonymous SNPs (nsSNPs) in ATG10, which may cause structural alterations and impact its interactions with other proteins. We found eleven mutations that could affect Atg10 stability, and six mutations that could increase the molecular flexibility. Y112N, P154L, and C166Y were found to have a high effect on the catalytic domain of Atg10 with a pathogenicity score > 0.9 in the tool MutPred2. Further, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed a change in the stability of the native structure in the presence of these mutations. Structural insights of the catalytic environment revealed a spatial arrangement that closely resembles the conserved configuration of canonical E2 enzymes. Additionally, two regulatory elements, 33 transcription factors, 13 phosphorylation, 2 SUMOylation, and 2 ubiquitination sites were predicted in Atg10. Based on these analyses, our study indicated that the identified missense SNPs could act as potential targets for various proteomic investigations, diagnostic approaches, and therapeutic strategies in future studies.
abstract_zh: 自噬相关基因10（Atg10），作为一种E2样酶，对于自噬体形成中的两种泛素样修饰至关重要：Atg12-Atg5结合和MAP-LC3脂化。它参与多种癌症、神经退行性疾病、自噬相关疾病以及对癌症的治疗反应。ATG10中的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）与多种疾病相关，导致患者的遗传易感性。在本研究中，我们运用多种计算机模拟工具来检查Atg10，以识别可作为分子标记的分子特征。我们分析了ATG10中有害的非同义单核苷酸多态性（nsSNPs），这些变异可能导致结构改变并影响其与其他蛋白质的相互作用。我们发现十一个突变可能影响Atg10的稳定性，六个突变可能增加分子灵活性。Y112N、P154L和C166Y被发现对Atg10的催化域有显著影响，在MutPred2工具中的致病性评分>0.9。此外，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟揭示了这些突变存在时天然结构稳定性的变化。对催化环境的结构洞察显示，其空间排列与典型E2酶的保守构型高度相似。另外，预测了Atg10中的两个调控元件、33个转录因子、13个磷酸化位点、2个SUMO化位点和2个泛素化位点。基于这些分析，我们的研究表明，所识别的错义SNPs可能作为未来研究中各种蛋白质组学调查、诊断方法和治疗策略的潜在靶点。
